ui.titulo: Menu Bar do Alemão Vila Olímpia · Parmegiana and German food
ui.historia: In 1902, Adolf Steiner opened a German confectionery in Itu with his son Max. That is where Bar do Alemão was born, and the family still runs it today.
ui.legal: Prices in Brazilian reais (R$). Photos are for illustration only.

ui.descricao: Menu of Bar do Alemão São Paulo in Vila Olímpia: original parmegiana from Itu, Eisbein, Kassler, filet mignon, Brahma draught beer and cocktails. Steiner family since 1902.

executivo.nota: Starter + Main course + Dessert. Available Monday to Friday from 11am to 3pm (except public holidays and delivery).

acompanhamentos.nota: Our side dishes serve 2 to 3 people.

parmegiana.nota: Delicious and original from Itu. All parmegianas come with white rice and your favourite potatoes: wedges or chips.

massas.eyebrow: Handmade tagliatelle or durum wheat spaghetti
massas.nota: Choose your favourite sauce. All family-size dishes serve 3 people.

kids.nota: For children up to 8 years old.

caipirinhas.nota: Brazil's national cocktail. Choose your flavour: pineapple, lime, strawberry, tangerine, red berries or passion fruit.

couvert.descricao: Seasoned eggplant, marinated olives, butter and a basket of warm bread.

pocket-batatas.descricao: To take home and enjoy anytime.

eisbein-aperitivo.descricao: German pork knuckle, crispy and tender. Served with a bread basket.

frango-passarinho.nome: Fried chicken bites with garlic and oil

file-aperitivo.descricao: Grilled filet mignon strips topped with Catupiry cream cheese. Served with a bread basket.

kassler-grelhado.descricao: Grilled smoked pork chop. Served with a bread basket.

mix-grill.descricao: Platter with Lyoner sausage, veal sausage and Kassler (all grilled), sauerkraut and potato wedges. Served with a bread basket.

mix-salsichas.descricao: Platter with Lyoner sausage, calabresa sausage (fried) and veal sausage (fried and boiled). Served with a bread basket.

isca-abadejo.descricao: Breaded and fried strips served with house mayonnaise.

salsichao-lyoner.descricao: German sausage made with pork and beef. Served boiled or fried.

caesar.descricao: Iceberg lettuce, croutons, parmesan, Caesar dressing.

campestre.descricao: Mixed lettuce, tomato, grated carrot, chopped heart of palm and mustard dressing.

ituana.descricao: Mixed lettuce, tomato, cucumber, heart of palm, cold cuts, peas, cooked vegetables, eggs and onion.

salada-alema.descricao: Boiled potatoes, mayonnaise dressing, cold cuts, veal pâté and Frankfurt sausage.

arroz-verde.descricao: White rice, parsley and parmesan cheese.

arroz-alemao.descricao: White rice, sausage, heart of palm, peas, parmesan cheese, red pepper and herbs.

eisbein.descricao: Tender pork knuckle with crispy crackling, pea purée, boiled potatoes, sauerkraut, Tyrolean onions and veal sausage.

kassler.descricao: Smoked pork chop, pea purée, boiled potatoes, sauerkraut and veal sausage.

salsichao-frankfurt.descricao: Tasty grilled sausage topped with cheese and bacon. Served with potato salad and sauerkraut.

file-cavalo.descricao: Grilled escalope topped with tomato and onion sauce. Served with white rice, fried egg and potato chips.

file-alemao.descricao: Grilled paillard stuffed with ham, cheese and tomato. Served with German-style rice, sautéed potatoes and boiled eggs.

chateaubriand.descricao: Grilled escalope topped with Madeira sauce and mushrooms. Served with mashed potatoes and rice.

file-milanesa.descricao: Crispy breaded filet served with rice and potato salad.

file-calabres.descricao: Grilled paillard stuffed with sautéed calabresa sausage and onions and provolone. Served with German-style rice and potato wedges with bacon, topped with roast gravy.

pizzaiolo.descricao: Grilled escalope topped with fresh tomato sauce and olives. Served with buttered tagliatelle.

poivre.descricao: Grilled escalope topped with Madeira sauce and green peppercorns. Served with potato wedges and white rice.

file-steiner.descricao: Grilled escalope served with heart of palm, onion and peas in butter, and potato chips.

strogonoff-mignon.descricao: Grilled strips in our traditional creamy sauce. Served with white rice and potato chips.

frango-chefe.descricao: Juicy deboned grilled spring chicken served with buttered vegetables and white rice.

belle-meuniere.descricao: Grilled pollock fillet topped with shrimp, mushroom and caper sauce. Served with sautéed potatoes and broccoli in olive oil.

massa-chefe.descricao: Sauce made with filet mignon, pork loin and fresh tomatoes.

canadense.descricao: Cream sauce with bacon and fresh tomatoes.

ravioli.descricao: Made with our handmade pasta, filled with buffalo mozzarella and topped with tomato sauce.
